body.statement: For all \(S,T\subseteq E^{?}\), if \(S\subseteq T\) and \(\operatorname{Fail}(S)=1\), then \(\operatorname{Fail}(T)=1\).
body.justification: Upward closure turns causal failure into a monotone Boolean property whose prime supports are exactly \(\mathcal O_{XY}\).
body.gap: Akbari et al. (2023, Lemma 3) prove the contrapositive formula-validity statement; this lemma records the exact support order used by the compiler.
body.consumer: It permits single-edge deletion tests for global minimality and the obstruction-free reliability formula.
